{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = df.isnull().sum()

# Check data types
dtypes = df.dtypes

# Check unique values in sex and responded columns
sex_unique = df['sex'].unique()
responded_unique = df['responded'].unique()

# Check the distribution of sex
sex_counts = df['sex'].value_counts()

# Print results
print("Missing values:\n", missing_values)
print("\nData types:\n", dtypes)
print("\nUnique values in sex:", sex_unique)
print("\nUnique values in responded:", responded_unique)
print("\nSex distribution:\n", sex_counts)"}
